applicableAreas: Street yard planting areas along Valley View Road
findings.comment: Three street yard trees are shown along the Valley View Road boundary on the landscape plan, but the plan does not explicitly label, dimension, or delineate planting zone boundaries or root barrier placements. Austin Water infrastructure locations are not clearly indicated on the landscape plan, making it impossible to verify that AW mains or services are not within any planting zones or confirm that the required 8-foot Street Tree Utility Gap is maintained between adjacent planting zones.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations (northwest, central west, central east, and south central areas)
findings.comment: The site facts document indicates a Parkland Deficient Area status with two polygon features intersecting the parcel, but precise parkland boundary coordinates are not provided in the available documents. While the electrical plan shows four transformer pads located within the depicted property boundary, the absence of an overlaid parkland boundary map prevents verification that transformers and utility boxes are completely excluded from parkland areas.

applicableAreas: Lot 1 boundaries and proposed utility easement areas
findings.comment: Site facts document records two critical utility easements (Greenbelt Access & Use, Instrument 2010070731, and City of Austin Drainage, Instrument 2011021137) that are not depicted on the submitted site plan plat. Without the recorded easement boundaries overlaid on proposed ROW lines, it cannot be verified whether these utility easement boundaries encroach into proposed public right-of-way or whether conflicting easements have been relocated or approved for modification.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations and electrical infrastructure areas
findings.comment: The site plan shows four electrical transformer pads but does not provide documentation of AE License Agreements from Austin Energy Public Involvement (required by UCM § 1.10.10.3) or City Manager licenses for items within public utility easements (§ 14-11-41). Furthermore, the site plan release notes state 'Additional electric easements may be required at a later date,' indicating that the transformer pad areas are not currently encumbered by dedicated AE easements. No license agreements or easement documentation are provided in the submittal.

applicableAreas: Proposed utility connections along Valley View Road
findings.comment: Utility tap plans show connections to existing public water and wastewater lines but do not include a detailed plan view with precise public ROW boundaries overlaid on the utility routing. Without ROW boundary mapping, it cannot be definitively verified whether any private utilities are located within public right-of-way or whether all private utilities have been properly relocated to private property or within dedicated private easements.

applicableAreas: Site interior areas where demolished building utilities previously existed
findings.comment: The site includes a demolished building (permit 2022-096813 BP, completed June 2022). Electrical plan notes reference the absence of abandoned utilities by checking field conditions, but the demolition plan details and confirmation of abandoned utility line removal are not provided in the reviewed plan materials. Without the demolition plan specifically identifying abandoned utilities and their removal/abandonment, clearance conflicts with proposed improvements cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Public ROW and property line boundary areas along Valley View Road
findings.comment: Utility tap plans show proposed connections to existing public utilities but do not include documentation that existing public or franchise utility service connections in the ROW have been removed, abandoned, plugged, capped, or terminated at the ROW/property line boundary by the respective utility companies prior to construction. Termination and abandonment records are not provided in the submittal.

applicableAreas: Existing and proposed power pole locations along Valley View Road
findings.comment: The electrical plan shows existing overhead electric poles in the public ROW along Valley View Road. However, no Austin Energy coordination letters, pole relocation analysis, or documentation of AE concurrence with any proposed pole relocations are included in the submittal. The site plan release notes reference potential additional electric easements, but coordination with AE regarding pole accessibility, clearances, and relocation feasibility (per UCM § 1.3.19) is not documented.

applicableAreas: Four transformer pad locations: northwest corner near entrance, central west area west of Bldg 2/8, central east area between Bldg 4/5, and south central area near Bldg 6/7
findings.comment: The electrical design plan shows four transformer pads but lacks critical documentation: (1) No AE Design specifications are referenced for pad dimensions — UCM § 1.5.2.6 requires pad sizing per AE Design based on customer AutoCAD drawings; (2) No clearance measurements are dimensioned on the plan to verify compliance with UCM § 1.10.4 requirements (10 feet from adjacent buildings on hot-stick side, 3 feet from removable ventilated fence on non-operator sides, 5 feet on operator sides, 2 feet from back of sidewalks); (3) No documentation of proximity to parking or traffic areas for the required 6-foot AE truck access per UCM § 1.10.4; (4) No dedicated AE easement is shown encumbering the pad areas — site plan notes state 'Additional electric easements may be required at a later date'; (5) No AE License Agreement documentation is provided per UCM § 1.10.10.3.
